(Nec latuit filios Benjamin quod ascendissent filii Israël in Maspha.)

And the Levite,
maritus mulieris interfectæ,

quomodo tantum scelus perpetratum esset,

respondit:

Veni in Gabaa Benjamin cum uxore mea,
“I went to Gibeah of Benjamin, with my wife,
illucque diverti:
and I diverted to that place.
et ecce homines civitatis illius circumdederunt nocte domum in qua manebam, volentes me occidere, et uxorem meam incredibili furore libidinis vexantes, denique mortua est.
And behold, the men of that city, at night, surrounded the house in which I was staying, intending to kill me. And they abused my wife with such an incredible fury of lust that in the end she died.
Quam arreptam,
And taking her up,
in frustra concidi,
I cut her into pieces,
misique partes in omnes terminos possessionis vestræ:
and I sent the parts into all the borders of your possession.
quia numquam tantum nefas,
For never before was such a nefarious crime,
et tam grande piaculum,
and so great a sin,
factum est in Israël.
committed in Israel.
Adestis,
You are all present here,
omnes filii Israël:
O sons of Israel.
decernite quid facere debeatis.
Discern what you ought to do.”
Stansque omnis populus,
And all the people, standing,
quasi unius hominis sermone respondit:
responded as if with the word of one man:
Non recedemus in tabernacula nostra,
“We shall not return to our own tents,
nec suam quisquam intrabit domum:
nor shall anyone enter into his own house.
sed hoc contra Gabaa in commune faciamus.

Decem viri eligantur e centum ex omnibus tribubus Israël, et centum de mille,

et mille de decem millibus,
and one thousand out of ten thousand,
ut comportent exercitui cibaria,

et possimus pugnare contra Gabaa Benjamin,

et reddere ei pro scelere, quod meretur.
and to repay it for its crime as it deserves.”
Convenitque universus Israël ad civitatem,

quasi homo unus eadem mente,
like one man,
unoque consilio.
with one mind and one counsel.

qui dicerent:
who said:

Deliver the men of Gibeah,
qui hoc flagitium perpetrarunt,
who have perpetrated this deplorable act,
ut moriantur,
so that they may die,
et auferatur malum de Israël.
and so that the evil may be taken away from Israel.”

quæ sortis suæ erant,

ut illis ferrent auxilium,

et non intellexerunt quod ex omni parte illis instaret interitus.

occurrerunt eis.

sexcenti viri:

cunctasque urbes et viculos Benjamin vorax flamma consumpsit.
